C1284.title: Wuxi Housing Provident Fund Loan Fraud: Identity Theft and Falsified Fund Records Used to Obtain Consumer Loans
C1284.summary: Between February and March 2021, a criminal ring led by Liang and Xue organized suspects across multiple regions to apply for personal consumer loans from banks in Wuxi using forged employment records and fabricated housing provident fund contribution histories.
